description: AI-powered automatic extraction of structured data from a web page. Set type to 'product' for e-commerce product pages (name, price, currency, images, SKU, availability...) or 'article' for news/blog pages (headline, author, date, body text...). Example: zyte_extract({ url: "https://shop.example.com/item/123", type: "product", _apiKey: "your-key" })

url.description: The URL of the product or article page to extract

name: zyte_extract
title: Zyte Extract
